questions.q: What is Judge Dredd's signature handgun called?
questions.why: The Lawgiver fires only for its owner's palm print.

questions.q: Judge Dredd patrols which sprawling metropolis of the future?
questions.why: Mega-City One sprawls along the east coast of North America.

questions.q: Who plays Dredd in the 2012 film Dredd?
questions.why: Karl Urban stars in the 2012 film Dredd, while Sylvester Stallone played him in 1995.

questions.q: Which villain leads the Dark Judges?
questions.why: Judge Death leads the Dark Judges, villains from another dimension who despise life.

questions.q: Dredd is a clone of which Chief Judge?
questions.why: Dredd is a clone of Chief Judge Eustace Fargo, and Rico is his clone brother.

questions.q: Which psychic Judge from Psi-Division is a recurring Dredd ally?
questions.why: Judge Anderson of Psi-Division is among Dredd's best-known allies.

questions.q: Which artist created Dredd's original design with writer John Wagner?
questions.why: Carlos Ezquerra drew the original design while John Wagner wrote the strip.

questions.q: Dredd made his debut in which numbered issue of 2000 AD?
questions.why: Dredd first appeared in 2000 AD prog 2, in 1977.

questions.q: Which storyline, running in progs 245-270, sees East-Meg One's nuclear strikes kill about half of the city's people?
questions.why: In The Apocalypse War, Soviet-style nuclear attacks cut Mega-City One's population from roughly 800 million to about 400 million.

questions.q: In what year did the Judge Dredd Megazine launch?
questions.why: Judge Dredd Megazine has been published since 1990.
